title: Words to read and colour: Words with sukoon from surahs we know
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 43 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 43. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Words with sukoon from surahs we know). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Sukoon in the middle
points: The quiet letter closes the syllable
Then carry on to the next letter

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read eight words with sukoon from Al-Kawthar, Al-Ikhlas and Al-Falaq; colour each sukoon red. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Eight words read with each sukoon coloured.

questions.q: Extend: write قُلْ on your whiteboard with its sukoon.
In «أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ», which letter has the first sukoon?
questions.a: A) ع. أَعْ: the 'ayn has a sukoon: a'-taynaaka.

questions.q: Think again: In «وَٱنْحَرْ» there are two quiet letters. Can you hear where your voice stops?
questions.a: On the noon (wan) and on the raa at the end (har): wanhar.
